activeWorkPacket.name: Minimal EVO Runtime Plugin Boundary
activeWorkPacket.businessGoal: Make EVO small enough to behave as an installable runtime plugin: accept BusinessData, execute supplied PostingRules, derive generic Ledger/Balance, and provide recalc/clear/export/query without owning platform, application, permission, finance-governance or rule-version concerns.
activeWorkPacket.evidenceTarget: DESIGN/STATUS ALIGNMENT — no runtime behavior change
closedGates: Application/Package/Feature/capability lifecycle externalized from Core target
Command reclassified as optional Host/compatibility adapter
openGates: plan bounded runtime convergence without breaking Proof C compatibility
activeWorkPacket.nextAction: Merge the design boundary, then define the smallest generic BusinessData submission adapter while retaining current /commands compatibility until Proof C/runtime migration is proven.

branchPolicy.workingRule: Use short-lived work-packet branches by default. Closely related bounded slices inside one confirmed business loop MAY be combined into one bundle branch when they share the same acceptance story and can be proven by one coherent database-E2E scenario. Merge the bundle to main before starting the next substantial independent capability.
branchPolicy.analysisRule: LLMs must use branch.topology.json plus live GitHub compare results before merge/delete/revival decisions.
branchPolicy.bundleRule: A bundle branch is allowed only when: (1) one confirmed business outcome unifies the slices; (2) acceptance and non-goals are explicit; (3) failures can still be localized to named sub-gates; (4) the PR remains reviewable; (5) database evidence covers the whole bundle; and (6) it does not introduce unrelated platform/generalization work.
branchPolicy.authorityRule: main is the only authoritative integration branch. ACTIVE_WORK branches are provisional. Once merged, mark them MERGED_MILESTONE and never merge them again.
branchPolicy.pacingRule: Do not create a branch/PR merely because a numbered sub-slice exists. Prefer one evidence-complete bundle over several mechanically small PRs when doing so reduces coordination overhead without weakening auditability.

forbiddenVolatileMarkers: uncited claims that a whole work packet is complete

requirementAlignment.rule: Technical design must keep EVO as a lightweight runtime plugin. Under uncertainty, move identity/application/governance/domain capabilities to Host/plugins; Core stays BusinessData → supplied PostingRules → Ledger/Balance plus runtime control/export.

alignmentCadence.rule: Perform a formal requirement-alignment review after every 3 merged DATABASE E2E VERIFIED/CERTIFIED bounded slices since the last review, or immediately when any mandatory trigger fires, whichever comes first.

requiredBeforeFinancialStatements: accounting book + accounting year/period + close/reopen governance
accounting currency / RMB statutory presentation rules
financialAccountingIntegrity.rule: Operational/economic ledgers remain increase/decrease based. Only the General Ledger accounting projection is subject to double-entry debit/credit integrity.
blocks: complete statutory financial statement package readiness claim
financialAccountingIntegrity.targetOwnership: FINANCE_PLUGIN / OPTIONAL DOMAIN PLUGIN — existing implementation retained as reusable asset, not mandatory minimal EVO Core

clearCacheDeletes: General Ledger/accounting projections derived from cleared runtime data
replay/materialization runtime state tied to cleared dataset
clearCachePreserves: nothing inside EVO runtime dataset except operational reset/status metadata required by the clear operation
rules/application/permission/package definitions are external to EVO Core and therefore not cache targets
runtimeDataLifecycle.postingRuleChange: plugin/package-owned rule lifecycle; Core consumes supplied current/governed rules and does not manage PostingRule versions
implementationDrift: current alpha metadata ties PostingRules to ApplicationDefinitionVersion; future bounded refactor must decouple Core rule execution from plugin-owned rule lifecycle

coreResponsibilities: accept generic BusinessData under opaque runtime scope
currentImplementationDrift: public /apps /capabilities /commands endpoints currently compose platform concerns inside EVO API
cost/valuation/accounting/reporting implementations are currently in-repo but target plugin ownership
